screens.name: 첫 만남
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a highly polished, production-quality visual design proposal for one full game screen, landscape 16:9, preferably 1920x1080 or larger. This is SCREEN 1 OF A COHESIVE FIVE-SCREEN Korean narrative idol survival and raising game called "RESCENE — 우리 여섯의 계절". It is a concept mockup, not a website, no browser chrome, no devices, no design board, one screen only.
Story beat: PROLOGUE / joining the team. The player joins five fictional stylized girl idol avatars as their sixth teammate, in a little seaside practice town. UI must feel like a premium handcrafted Korean/Japanese illustrated life simulation, an isometric village combined with intimate visual novel dialogue. Original art, not a copy of any existing game. No photographic likeness of real people.
Visual identity: ocean teal #8CBBC4, sage foliage #A8C29A, ink blue #344C5D, warm paper #EEE5CC, roofs #B88678, muted brass #D8BA7D. Carefully painted miniature isometric town with real spatial detail, soft afternoon sun, blue sea, coastal paths, practice studio with large windows, dormitory, small performance hall, flowering trees. Five distinct small female avatars in modest contemporary rehearsal clothes, one empty seat/table place implies the player. Keep five consistent identities: Woni dark brown bob green accent, Liv long black hair slate blue accent, Minami chestnut ponytail cobalt accent, May medium warm brown hair ochre accent, Zena long black hair with bangs lilac accent. Avatars stylized 3-head-tall, portraits softly drawn mature anime illustration, expressive but not oversized.
UI hierarchy: slim 64px top bar with elegant small serif RESCENE logo and Korean title "우리 여섯의 계절", right "프롤로그" and settings icon. About 72% of middle screen is immersive isometric village, no grid overlay. Left narrow vertical paper navigation with five clear icons and labels "숙소", "연습실", "회의실", "공연장", "기록실"; meeting location highlighted. Right modest paper objective sheet heading "첫 만남" and exact short text "다섯 멤버와 인사를 나눠요", with five small labeled portraits "원이", "리브", "미나미", "메이", "제나". Bottom 20% full-width paper dialogue panel with portrait on left, name "원이", single clear Korean line "마지막 한 사람, 기다리고 있었어.", and one large ink-teal primary button lower right "함께 시작하기". This CTA is the visual focus among controls. Tiny unobtrusive bottom left label "디자인 시안 · 예시 대사".
Typography: beautiful restrained Korean serif for story headings, clean readable Korean sans for controls, excellent contrast, generous whitespace, clean edges, large legible text. Use exact short Korean labels only, no fake paragraphs or pseudo-text. UI panels should be solid readable paper, not muddy translucent panels. Warmth comes from the game world, not generic rounded dashboard cards. This is an actual believable game UI composition with safe margins and touch sized buttons, thoughtful spatial hierarchy. Avoid busy HUD, currencies, stats everywhere, thick gold ornament, generic SaaS cards, glossy 3D mobile gacha, purple gradients, super tiny text, excessive decorative badges.

screens.name: 함께 정하는 무대
screens.prompt:
Use case ui-mockup. Generate a NEW standalone landscape 16:9 game UI concept screenshot in the same game as the reference. The reference image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER CONTINUITY reference, not an edit target; design a different screen. One full screen only, no device or browser frame. Maintain reference's art quality, restrained paper UI, ocean teal #8CBBC4, sage #A8C29A, dark ink #344C5D, paper #EEE5CC, roofs #B88678, brass #D8BA7D, painterly isometric architecture, same FIVE fictional female avatars with distinct reference hairstyles and outfits (Woni green short bob; Liv slate long black; Minami blue brown ponytail; May ochre brown medium hair; Zena lilac long black bangs). Title "RESCENE — 우리 여섯의 계절". Stylized original portraits, no photographic real-person likeness. Keep Korean labels crisp, readable, spelled correctly and minimal, no tiny long text. Korean serif headings and plain Korean sans controls, clear contrast. Only one visually dominant primary action. Left location navigation consistent where specified: 숙소 / 연습실 / 회의실 / 공연장 / 기록실. Solid paper backgrounds behind text. Remove excess invented English decorative slogans and decorative handwriting from reference; quieter UI, stronger legibility. This is a design proposal using example data, small footer "디자인 시안 · 예시 데이터".
SCREEN 2 — PREPARATION AND TEAM CONSENSUS. A believable dense but elegantly organized game screen, preparing Round 3 of 10 "기억의 향기". Left rail highlights "회의실". Slim header, four step strip "컨셉 확인 — 상의와 연습 — 공연 — 회고" with second active. Main composition: 40% width on left is a beautiful cutaway isometric rehearsal room by sea with five members talking around a piano and schedule desk. 60% right is a single spacious paper "이번 무대의 약속" work surface. Show selected song "잔광", mood "부드러운 흐름", risk "승부수 없음" as a restrained one-row plan summary. Below is five-row allocation ledger, columns "멤버", "연습", "휴식", with integer allocations Woni 2 / 1, Liv 2 / 0, Minami 1 / 1, May 2 / 0, Zena 2 / 1: total 12 exactly. Draw 12 blocks segmented by member and label "12 / 12 배분 완료". Small minus/plus controls clearly touchable. At bottom of paper six small vote avatars/circles for five members + "나", state "찬성 4 · 반대 1 · 내 의견 대기" and explanation "계획을 바꾸면 다시 상의해요". LOWER dialogue panel with Minami portrait and exact example line "이번엔 쉬는 시간도 함께 정해 볼까?" supporting two discrete controls: outlined "다른 의견 내기" and visually dominant teal "이 계획에 동의". Do not show a performance-start button because player has not voted. Distinguish example dialogue from real output. Prioritize useful interface and whitespace, no generic card grid.

SCREEN 3 — PERFORMANCE / WATCHING OUR SHARED PLAN. Dramatic but intimate illustrated concert scene taking 80% of screen. Evening navy sea-facing small theater, indigo canopy and warm brass stage lights, sage and rose accent lights. Exactly five full-body female avatars performing in coordinated navy/cream stage outfits, same distinct reference hairstyles, Liv in center singing a fictional performance. Elegant UI switches to dark ink navy with ivory text and muted brass active accents, the shape language stays the same as reference. Top title RESCENE and Korean subtitle, top center "Round 3 / 10", simple back control "마을로". Top-left narrow song overlay "기억의 향기" and "잔광". NO busy navigation sidebar during playback. Small center-stage tag "지금의 중심 · 리브" located without obscuring face. Bottom solid dark panel: large transport pause icon, time "00:24 / 01:00", five equal clickable timeline segments labeled "원이", "미나미", "리브", "메이", "제나", with third highlighted (the 24-second segment). One line "서로의 호흡을 잇는 무대". Small utility buttons "처음부터", "음량". Right bottom quiet outlined action "합의한 계획 보기". Lower edge text "연주곡과 캐릭터 연출 시안". This screen is a listening/viewing experience, not a rhythm minigame: no tap circles, no score popup, no attack controls, no invented singing waveform or real vocals claim, no autoplay-next. Cinematic stage composition, readable controls, no confetti yet, focus on the group.

SCREEN 4 — SETBACK, REFLECTION, GROWTH. After a lost head-to-head match but SURVIVED elimination. Emotionally warm, quiet night in dorm overlooking seaside lighthouse. Left rail highlights "기록실", top says "Round 3 / 10". Five fictional avatars sitting around a warm table with tea, one making notes, helping each other, no exaggerated crying. Half screen on left art, right half a large open paper growth notebook. Prominent human-readable result "이번 대결은 패배, 다음 라운드 진출". Smaller "전체 8위 / 16팀" so loss is not confused with elimination. Notebook headline "오늘을 다음 무대로". Two clear editorial sections connected with a hand-drawn thin line: "이번 무대의 기록" with sample evidence "후반부 호흡이 흔들렸어요"; "다음에 시도할 약속" with "휴식을 늘려 다시 맞춰 보기" and small status "아직 검증 전". Five member tabs with names, Minami active, one selectable short team reflection line "속도보다 함께 끝내는 호흡을 기억하자". Indicate pin action "팀의 기억으로 남기기" via bookmark icon, not fake proven growth score. Bottom dialogue bar Minami portrait, sample line "아쉬운 부분을 알았으니, 다음엔 다르게 해보자." One dominant CTA "다음 라운드 준비", secondary quiet "무대 다시 보기". Avoid celebrating failure falsely, no causal improvement charts, no mandatory choice hiding progression, no shame red alarms. Show history and future intent separately. Same art/paper palette, cozy lamplight, spacious readable layout.

SCREEN 5 — SEASON FINALE / EXAMPLE CHAMPION ENDING. Final round 10 of 10, an EXAMPLE VICTORY BRANCH, not a guaranteed outcome. Full-width theatrical celebration illustration with five reference avatars in refined coordinated ivory/navy stagewear bowing together on a coastal outdoor stage at dawn, tasteful golden confetti, town rooftops and sea in distance, empty front-row seat with a small program subtly representing the sixth teammate; exactly five on-stage characters. This is a game result interface, not a poster. Top small RESCENE title and "Round 10 / 10 · 시즌 완료". Large but restrained Korean serif heading "우리 여섯이 만든 계절". Small clear brass badge "우승 엔딩 예시". At right an elegant paper foldout "함께 남긴 기록" with three miniature illustrated memory vignettes arranged vertically and labeled "첫 합의", "다시 맞춘 호흡", "마지막 무대"; no made-up numerical grind achievements. Bottom full-width ivory dialogue panel with Woni portrait and exact line "첫 연습실의 약속이 여기까지 이어졌네." Primary teal action "이번 시즌 기록 보기", secondary outlined "새 시즌 준비". Below secondary small practical label "기존 시즌은 보관돼요". A small unobtrusive footer "디자인 시안 · 우승 분기". Emphasize shared growth and closure rather than giant trophy/reward chest, no purchase/shop button, no compulsory restart. Typography readable, generous hierarchy, outstanding painterly finish consistent with reference.
